title: Exploring Upper MutantMania

html:
Quest Giver: Loremaster Vraile

Quest Type: Discover

Quest Description: Explore the many branches connected to Upper MutantMania. Afterward, return to Loremaster Vraile in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Loremaster Vraile

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Exploring Lower MutantMania

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Explore the many branches connected to Upper MutantMania. Afterward, return to Loremaster Vraile in Townston.

Offer:

MutantMania? Yes, yes...I...I know of it.

Pardon my stammering, Dungeon Runner. I...I am embarrassed to admit the violent brawls contained within the MutantMania are a guilty pleasure of mine. Embarrassed because I am a seeker of knowledge, a learned man! And yet...have you seen Babyface Buster perform his Suicide Swaddle attack? Pure poetry in motion! We must not simply read and listen, my child. Skilled observation may also grant knowledge.

Go into the MutantMania. Watch the combatants. *Comprehend* what they do. Once you have gained a modicum of understanding for what it takes to be a professional in the MutantMania circuit, return to me.

Turn-in:

Ah, so you have returned from MutantMania's upper branches. What have you learned? You have learned, perhaps, that there is much that you have yet to learn?

Objectives:

  • Explore Bernie's Backyard Brawl
  • Explore the All-Amateur Assault
  • Explore the Upper Umbrage Unleashed

Client level range: 80–100
